name: Raven Roost Cutthroat

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale

items.name: Studded Leather
items.description:
Studded leather is leather armor reinforced with metal studs. It provides a middle ground between hide armor and ring mail. It is more flexible than either, while its reinforced construction gives it a slight edge over hide.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Studded leather grants +4 AC at levels 16-25, and +5 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Garrote
items.description: This strangling tool is a length of wire or knotted rope with handles at either end. The only attacks that you can make with a garrote are ones that require or allow its use. Also, if you are holding a garrote in both hands, you can use the grab action even without a hand free. If the grab hits, the target takes 1[W] damage from the garrote.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Garrote
powers.requirements: The cutthroat must not be grabbing a creature.

hit.description: The target is grabbed (escape DC 22) until the end of the cutthroat’s next turn. Until the grab ends, the cutthroat has superior cover, and neither it nor the target can be pulled, pushed, or slid.

effect.description: Melee 1 (one creature grabbed by the cutthroat). The target takes 2d10 + 5 damage, and ongoing 10 damage (save ends). The grab then ends.

powers.name: Quick Cut
powers.trigger: An enemy escapes the cutthroat’s grab.

effect.description: The cutthroat uses dagger against the triggering enemy.
